label.en: Old phone dies at the station tower
label.hr: Stari mobitel se gasi kod odašiljača na kolodvoru

label.en: New SIM blips once at the same tower, morning
label.hr: Novi SIM se jednom javi na istom odašiljaču, ujutro

label.en: Meeting Filip by the plane tree, noon
label.hr: Sastanak s Filipom kod platane, u podne

label.en: Boarding call for the coastal train, dusk
label.hr: Poziv za ukrcaj na primorski vlak, u sumrak
Stari plakat za nestalu, netko drugi

hints.en: Five real moments: a call, a dead phone, a ping, a meeting, a train. Everything else in the pool is noise.
hints.hr: Pet stvarnih trenutaka: poziv, ugašen mobitel, javljanje, sastanak, vlak. Sve ostalo u skupu je buka.

hints.en: Order: 00:41 call → the old phone dies → the new SIM blips → noon at the plane tree → the evening train.
hints.hr: Redoslijed: poziv u 00:41 → gasi se stari mobitel → javlja se novi SIM → podne kod platane → večernji vlak.
